theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_local_cauchy_of_mollified_cauchy
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Set (Rn N)) (ρ : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ), (∀ k, NullMeasurableSet (F k) volume) → (∀ m, Continuous (ρ m)) → (∀ m, HasCompactSupport (ρ m)) → (∀ m y, 0 ≤ ρ m y) → (∀ m, ∫ y, ρ m y = 1) → (∀ m, Function.support (ρ m) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) → (∀ R : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ h : Rn N, ‖h‖ ≤ 1 → volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R ∩ symmDiff ((fun y ↦ y + h) ⁻¹' F k) (F k)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) → (∀ (m : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ l ≥ k₀, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) m, |(∫ z in F k, ρ m (y - z)) - ∫ z in F l, ρ m (y - z)| ≤ ε) → ∀ (R : ℕ) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < ε → ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ l ≥ k₀, volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R ∩ symmDiff (F k) (F l)) ≤ ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
